positive.description: P1. Read-only catalog discovery and template selection. Not run in submission host. Setup: authenticated dedicated review account and packaged v2.0.0 app; no draft should be created. Use the separate Demo workspace with fictional records.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_templates with {"workspace":"demo"} and open_library with {"workspace":"demo","template_id":"sample_project_brief"}. Return summary pages containing the 35 built-ins and owned demo custom templates. Follow nextCursor as after_id until hasMore=false; read the selected full body and fields with open_library. Open the interactive library with Project brief selected and fields project_name, goal, audience, constraints, success_criteria. Do not call prepare_draft, update_draft, or save_template. positive.description: P2. Partial fill with explicit provenance and missing data. Not run in submission host. Setup: a fresh review conversation using only the fictional details in the prompt. Retain the returned draft identifier for P3. Use the separate Demo workspace with fictional records.
positive.prompt: Use the Demo workspace. Use Project brief for a fictional project named Orchard. The goal is Welcome 20 local readers, with Costs under £100 as the constraint. Use Local book-club members as a provisional audience assumption and mark it inferred. I haven't set success criteria. Fill a draft for review; don't execute it.

Omit success_criteria or leave it empty. Return a version-1 saved draft with only success_criteria missing and {{success_criteria}} visible in renderedPrompt. Show three provided fields, one inferred field and one missing field. Do not execute or submit the prompt, invent missing criteria, or include a transcript. The UI blocks copy while required data is missing. Include workspace=demo on every related tool call. Read renderedPrompt and missingFields inside draft in the version-2 contract.

The audience Local book-club members is now confirmed, and the success criterion is 20 RSVPs by Friday. Keep the project name and goal. Save the changes, reopen the draft, and show the saved rendered prompt for review. Don't run it.

Call update_draft on that identifier with the returned version (1 under the fixture) and all five values, source=provided: project_name=Orchard; goal=Welcome 20 local readers; audience=Local book-club members; constraints=Costs under £80; success_criteria=20 RSVPs by Friday. Reopen with open_library on the same draft_id and read render_prompt on that draft_id. The saved version advances to 2, all values persist, missingFields is empty, and the rendered text contains no unresolved placeholders. Do not call prepare_draft or execute the rendered prompt. A manual Copy prompt action makes an additional render_prompt freshness check; verify actual copied or selectable-fallback text separately in the host. Include workspace=demo on every related tool call. Read renderedPrompt and missingFields inside draft in the version-2 contract.

positive.description: P5. Custom template save/update and draft snapshot stability. Not run in submission host. Setup: dedicated test account with only fictional fixture data; reuse identifiers returned by this case, never guessed identifiers or real user records. Prepare that template with River as the person and save its draft for review. Then change the saved template body to Welcome {{person}}. Keep its name, description, and category. Use the returned template id in prepare_draft with values [{"key":"person","value":"River","source":"provided"}]. Capture the returned draft id. Update the same custom template using save_template with its returned template_id, the same title/description/category, and body "Welcome {{person}}.". Finally call render_prompt with the captured draft_id. The current custom template has the new body while the draft remains version 1 and renders exactly "Hello River." with no missing fields. Do not update that draft or execute the prompt. Read-only list_templates/open_library calls are allowed if needed to resolve the newly returned fixture. Include workspace=demo on every related tool call. Read renderedPrompt and missingFields inside draft in the version-2 contract.
